texto_es: Break the rules. Change the game! Activate Overrides to switch up the game and explore areas inspired by gaming legends like Sonic, Tetris, and Pac-Man as the future of the Island unfolds.

texto_es: There are all new Sprites to discover and collect! Extract and equip them for game-changing Sprite Powers, level them up, and keep growing the Collection in Override. Sprites will now appear in Ranked too, with abilities disabled to maintain even competition.

texto_es: Stay connected anywhere! Party up and voice chat with friends across Fortnite, the Epic Games Launcher, and the Epic Games mobile app. Move voice chat between devices, background the app and keep chatting on the go, and automatically land in the same Fortnite Lobby when friends accept your invite.
